DISTRIBUTION (map 15): Known only from the type locality, Newman Rocks, east of Norseman, Western Australia.
Distribution. Type locality: Russia, Primorye, Partisansk. Palaearctic: Russia (Kuriles, Primorye).

Distribution in Iran. Khuzestan: Susa [= Shūsh] (Wittmer 1972; Delkeskamp 1977). Generic records: Iran (Kazantsev & Brancucci 2007).
